title: Explore a raga from library into studio and compose with playback
description: Verifies a learner can open a raga from the library in the studio, create a sequencer pattern, start playback, switch instruments, and still be constrained to the loaded raga.

steps.description: Navigate to /library
Click a raga card to view it in the studio
Play a few notes on the virtual piano
Toggle several steps on the sequencer grid to create a pattern
Start playback
Change the instrument to a different timbre
Verify the studio shows the selected raga as loaded and the available notes are constrained to that raga during interaction
Verify playback is running and the sequencer pattern is actively playing

title: Load a raga directly in studio and build a loop
description: Verifies an anonymous user can load a raga in the studio, interact with instruments and sequencer, and hear the loop during playback.

steps.description: Navigate to /studio
Select a raga to load its notes
Play a few notes on the virtual piano or drum pads
Toggle multiple steps on the sequencer grid
Start playback
Verify the selected raga is loaded into the studio
Verify the sequencer loop is playing

title: Open a selected raga from library in studio with context preserved
description: Verifies selecting a raga in the library opens the studio with that raga already loaded.

steps.description: Navigate to /library
Click a specific raga card to open it in the studio
Verify the studio loads with a raga already selected from the library choice
Verify the loaded raga’s note set is shown in the studio context

title: Open a project in the studio, save changes, and see it updated on the dashboard
description: Verifies that an authenticated composer can open an existing project in the studio, save an update, return to the dashboard, and see the project updated.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill {{LOGIN_USER}} into the email field
Fill {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}} into the password field
Submit the login form
Initiate project creation
Fill Project Beta into the project title field
Select a raga for the project
Save the project
Open the Project Beta project from the dashboard
Make a composition change in the studio by toggling at least one sequencer step
Save the project update from the studio
Return to the dashboard from the studio
Verify the Project Beta project shows an updated indicator such as a newer timestamp or updated metadata

title: Sign in with email/password and reach dashboard
description: Verifies a member can sign in using email/password and is taken to the projects dashboard.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill {{LOGIN_USER}} into the email field
Fill {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}} into the password field
Submit the login form
Verify the user lands on the dashboard
Verify the projects dashboard content is displayed

title: Sign in to access the dashboard
description: Verifies that a user can sign in with email and password and is taken to the dashboard upon success.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill {{LOGIN_USER}} into the email field
Fill {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}} into the password field
Submit the login form
Verify the user lands on the dashboard

title: AI assistant streams a response for a raga question in studio
description: Verifies a student can submit a raga-related question in the studio and receive a streamed assistant response appended to the chat.

steps.description: Navigate to /studio
Select a raga to load its notes
Fill a raga-specific question into the chat input
Submit the chat message
Verify the assistant response appears in the chat and continues updating as it streams
Verify the response completes and remains visible in the chat history

title: Create a new project from the dashboard
description: Verifies that an authenticated composer can create a project with a title and raga and then see it listed on the dashboard.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill {{LOGIN_USER}} into the email field
Fill {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}} into the password field
Submit the login form
Initiate project creation
Fill Project Alpha into the project title field
Select a raga for the project
Save the project
Verify the new project is listed on the dashboard

title: Redirect unauthenticated user from dashboard to login
description: Verifies a logged-out visitor attempting to access the dashboard is redirected to the login page.

steps.description: Navigate to /dashboard
Verify the user is redirected to the login page
Verify the login form is displayed

title: Export a non-empty composition as MIDI with a valid BPM
description: Verifies that creating a composition with at least one layer and a BPM within 60–200 allows MIDI export to complete and produces a MIDI download result.

steps.description: Navigate to /studio
Click once in the studio to initialize audio and interaction context
Ensure the composition has at least one active layer by creating or enabling a layer
Toggle at least one sequencer step to make the composition non-empty
Set BPM to a value within the allowed range
Export the composition as MIDI
Verify a MIDI export completion indicator is visible

title: Drone and tonic establishment in a single session
description: Verifies a user can enable the drone, establish tonic via instrument interaction, and stop playback while keeping the session state intact.

steps.description: Navigate to /studio
Select a raga to load its notes
Toggle the drone on
Play a note on the virtual piano to establish a tonic reference
Start playback
Stop playback
Verify the drone remains enabled after stopping playback
Verify the current session composition state remains available for continued editing

title: Instrument switching preserves the current pattern
description: Verifies switching between available instruments does not clear the existing sequencer pattern or interrupt the ability to continue composing.

steps.description: Navigate to /studio
Select a raga to load its notes
Toggle several steps on the sequencer grid to create a recognizable pattern
Change the instrument to a different timbre
Start playback
Verify the sequencer pattern remains present after instrument switching
Verify playback still runs with the current pattern using the newly selected instrument

title: Browse raga metadata in library without launching studio
description: Verifies a learner can view raga details such as aroha/avaroha and other metadata from the library browsing experience.

steps.description: Navigate to /library
Scroll through the raga list
Open a raga’s details panel or expanded view from the library
Verify raga metadata such as aroha/avaroha and other descriptive fields are displayed
Verify the user remains in the library browsing context without entering the studio

title: First-gesture audio initialization enables audible playback
description: Verifies the audio engine becomes active only after a user gesture and then supports starting playback within the studio.

steps.description: Navigate to /studio
Select a raga to load its notes
Attempt to start playback without first interacting with any instrument or grid
Perform a user gesture by playing a note on the virtual piano
Start playback
Verify playback can run after the first user gesture initializes audio
Verify any audio-start guidance or blocked-audio indication is no longer shown after initialization

title: Block MIDI export when BPM is below the allowed minimum
description: Verifies that setting BPM below the allowed minimum prevents MIDI export and shows a BPM range validation error.

steps.description: Navigate to /studio
Click once in the studio to initialize audio and interaction context
Set BPM to 50
Attempt to export the composition as MIDI
Verify a BPM range validation error is visible

title: Require a title when creating a project
description: Verifies that leaving the project title empty prevents saving and shows a required-title validation error.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill {{LOGIN_USER}} into the email field
Fill {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}} into the password field
Submit the login form
Initiate project creation
Leave the project title field empty
Select a raga for the project
Attempt to save the project
Verify a title-required validation error is visible

title: AI assistant rejects an empty message
description: Verifies submitting an empty chat message is blocked with a validation error and no new assistant response is added.

steps.description: Navigate to /studio
Focus the chat input
Press Enter to submit without entering any message
Verify a message validation error is visible
Verify no new assistant response is added to the chat thread

title: Reject invalid login credentials
description: Verifies that submitting incorrect credentials shows an authentication error and the user remains on the login page.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill invalid-user@example.com into the email field
Fill wrong-password into the password field
Submit the login form
Verify an authentication error is visible
Verify the user remains on the login page

title: Invalid credentials show login error and do not navigate
description: Verifies entering invalid email/password shows an authentication error while remaining on the login page.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill invalid@example.com into the email field
Fill wrong-password into the password field
Submit the login form
Verify an authentication error is visible
Verify the user remains on the login page
